Synopsis:
Omeluum mind melds with the player and asks for help and also reveals a mental visualization of the whole facility with indications for locations of hostages and enemies as well as any other useful information.

Cluster Contexts:
- IRN_IronThrone_OmeluumMindMeld.json: You’re docked at the submerged Iron Throne complex’s upper level just after Lord Gortash triggered explosives; alarms, power flickers, and collapsing structure mean the facility is rapidly destabilizing and you have only a short window to act. Omeluum — a scholar of the Society of Brilliance who was captured while investigating the Foundry/Iron Throne — mind‑melds with you, urgently asking for help and projecting a mental map of the facility that marks hostage locations (which can include Grand Duke Ravengard) and enemy positions plus other useful details. His visualization is meant to guide an immediate rescue and escape before sections fail. Off‑screen events like what happened in the Steel Watch Foundry or the Neurocitor/Control Centre, and your prior dealings with Gortash or the Netherstones, may already have altered guard presence, who lives, and how the rescue can proceed.
- TUT_TransformChamber_PodGirl.json: Occurs if the player clicks on the first mind flayer pod with someone inside. They can attempt to free the captive - Shadowheart - but the magical runes guarding the pod prevent this.The player can leave her stuck, or try to find another way to free her. Via a skillcheck or via Shadowheart herself, they may receive a clue to examine the console next to the pod.
- MOO_Docks_Checkpoint.json: The guard mindmelds with player, senses their tadpole, and gladly lets them into the towers, telling them to report to Disciple Z'rell (Zuh-rELL).
- Astarion_Recruitment.json: Following a trail of whispered ADs ('Psst. Over here!' 'Come on, before it's too late!') we find a pale elf, hunched down near some long grass. He insists an intellect devourer (brain monster with legs) is hiding there, trying to cajole you to look and kill it. If you approach the grass, a boar bursts out - it was a distraction while Astarion got behind you. He's on edge, but pleased to have the jump on you. He holds a blade to your throat while demanding you tell him what happened on the ship. After a mind meld (vision where he sees a glimpse of your past) you can convince him that you're both victims and should work together to find an answer. Once he realises you're not a threat his tone changes from threatening to charming.
- DEN_AttackOnDen_RaidersArriveBeforeFight.json: The scene opens the moment the player blows the horn to begin an assault on the Grove gates: the surviving tiefling leader (Zevlor) has rallied the refugees while Minthara, a drow commander, arrives with her goblin retinue and immediately mind‑melds with the player, presuming — as she does with all True Souls — that the player will betray the tieflings. Off‑screen, these tieflings are refugees from Elturel who have been sheltered in the Emerald Grove while the druids (led by First Druid Kagha) prepare a ritual to shut the grove to outsiders; Zevlor is bitter, desperate, and secretly self‑serving, having already tried and failed to parley with the druids. The player has likely just helped repel an earlier goblin attack at the gate and may have had optional interactions with tieflings (for example inspiring trainees with Asharak) or with Zevlor that affect loyalties and morale. This is a large, decisive battle that will determine the fate of the tieflings, the drow/goblin force, and the player's standing.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Omeluum: Halt. (node 6)
- Narrator: *A cold, suckering wetness grasps at your mind. A voice, familiar to you from the Underdark, wraps itself around your brain.* (node 30)
- Omeluum: You have arrived at an optimal time. Collapse is imminent, and there are hostages in need of aid. (node 20)
- Player: How do I get to the hostages? (node 33)
- Player: Tell me what to do. (node 31)

context: You’re aboard the upper level of the submerged Iron Throne complex just after Lord Gortash set off explosives; alarms are blaring, power is failing, and parts of the facility are already collapsing, so you have only a short window to act. Omeluum — a Society of Brilliance scholar who was captured while investigating the Foundry/Iron Throne — mentally mind‑melds with you, urgently asking for help and projecting a mental map of the facility. His visualization flags hostage locations (which can include Grand Duke Ravengard), enemy positions, and other tactical details meant to guide an immediate rescue and escape. Off‑screen events (for example in the Steel Watch Foundry or the Neurocitor/Control Centre) and your prior dealings with Gortash or the Netherstones may already have altered guard deployments and who is still alive.
